ownerDecision: Use appropriately licensed real automotive stock photography instead of planned AI-generated photographs.
rightsPolicy: Select only photographs with explicit verified CC0 1.0 Commons source records; preserve incidental branding and do not imply endorsement.

visualReview.method: Reviewed the complete 30-photo contact sheet after replacing unsuitable candidates; full source frames preserved.
visualReview.defaultFinding: Real automotive photograph; entire principal vehicle visible; body style matches mapping; incidental OEM badges retained and no endorsement implied.

viewNotes.aurelia_ex.webp: Elevated front-three-quarter view; whole coupe visible; normal small BMW badge retained.
viewNotes.cascadia_sport.webp: Rear-three-quarter alternative, not the preferred front view; entire contemporary wagon visible; incidental VW/model badges retained.
viewNotes.halcyon_lx.webp: Side/front-quarter alternative; entire modern hatchback visible; small OEM badge retained.
viewNotes.meridian_limited.webp: Elevated front-three-quarter alternative; entire contemporary coupe visible; no billboard/foreground crowd.
viewNotes.meridian_premium.webp: Elevated front-quarter view with natural shade; full coupe visible; no branding removed.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Prominent company branding on pickup door.
Underlit rear view with conspicuous advertising flags; replaced with a clean pickup photograph.
Distant rear driving view, weak inventory-card composition.
Prominent Nissan display billboard and tight composition.
Prominent Ford display branding and foreground show crowd.
Utility-bed pickup with rear frame/occlusion unsuitable for clean whole-vehicle presentation.
